title: Why Every Household Needs a VPN in 2026
description: Public Wi-Fi, ISP tracking, and geo-blocked content are all good reasons to use a VPN. This guide explains what to look for before claiming a deal.

sections.heading: What a VPN protects
sections.body: A VPN encrypts traffic between your device and the VPN provider, reducing exposure on public Wi-Fi and limiting casual network tracking.

sections.heading: How to compare offers
sections.body: Prioritize no-log policies, device support, refund terms, and speed before choosing the largest advertised discount.

title: 5 Budget Apps That Actually Changed How I Spend
description: A practical review of budgeting app features that actually help users understand subscriptions, spending habits, and saving goals.

sections.heading: Features that matter
sections.body: Useful budget apps make recurring charges obvious, categorize spending cleanly, and turn insights into simple next actions.

sections.heading: When a free trial is worth it
sections.body: A trial is valuable when it lets you connect accounts, test notifications, and export your data before committing.

title: The Complete Guide to Cloud Storage: What, Why, and How Much
description: A plain-English guide to choosing storage for photos, documents, backups, and shared files without overpaying.

sections.heading: How much storage you need
sections.body: Most households need enough space for photos, phone backups, and important documents, plus room for growth over the next year.

sections.heading: Security and recovery
sections.body: Look for account recovery options, two-factor authentication, and clear file version history before moving critical files.
